messages:
Alex Carter: quick heads-up — Kitterly's usage dropped hard last week after the new cto joined. saw seat activity fall 62% in Grafana alert.
Jamal Ortiz: ugh. did we get any heads-up from the AE/AM?
Alex Carter: no, AE handed to Jamal last month but there was no CTO intro. customer didn't reply to my last 2 emails.
Nora Liu: I pulled the event logs — last successful inference calls were 5 days ago. their largest integration (etl-sync) has failed 3 times in past 10 days.
Alex Carter: here's the quick metrics snapshot I pasted to the customer thread: 
```
Last 7d: active_users: 14 (prev 38)
Avg tokens/day: 8.6k (prev 42k)
Failed jobs: 3 (etl-sync)
Top model: rdl-3-llama-13b (no recent calls)
```
Jamal Ortiz: any sign they're evaluating competitors?
Alex Carter: yes — procurement asked for a POC with VendorX last week per a note in the workspace. they mentioned “better latency at scale”.
Nora Liu: we should triage both technical and commercial signals. technical: I can offer a one-off remediation workshop to unstick etl-sync and run a perf profile. commercial: Jamal, can you check contract timeline and whether we can offer a short credit for a dedicated capacity trial?
Jamal Ortiz: contract renewal in 10 weeks. I'll push procurement for clarity and see if legal okays a 30-day Dedicated trial credit.
Alex Carter: def offer the workshop first. propose 30-min call with their new CTO + eng lead. Nora — can you make a short checklist for the workshop? "What to bring" items (logs, config, sample payloads)?
Nora Liu: will do. draft checklist below and I can drop into the customer email: 
- latest etl-sync logs (last 72h)
- example payloads that hit the large-seq path
- token distribution (avg/max)
- any quantization/float32 flags in deployment
- preferred 30-min time slots
Alex Carter: nice. I'll draft the outreach and include a soft ask: are they evaluating VendorX? need to know their must-have (latency/cost/feature parity).
ops-bot: incident alert: etl-sync job failures spike for customer=kitterly at 2026-03-18T09:12:45Z (ticket #INC-8721).
Jamal Ortiz: ops-bot noted an incident ticket too — Nora, can you pick the remediation runbook and estimate time?
Nora Liu: remediation runbook selected: "etl-retry-and-params". estimate 2-3 hours to reproduce/fix; workshop prep 1 hour.
Alex Carter: ok action items: Alex -> send outreach (today EOD), Jamal -> commercial check (48h), Nora -> remediation + checklist (48h). I'll schedule a triage sync on Friday 10am PT if everyone ok.
Jamal Ortiz: ok for Fri 10am PT. I'll DM legal if we need to accelerate trial credit approval.
Nora Liu: ok. I'll start reproducing the failure now and paste findings in thread.
Alex Carter: thanks team. tagging @jamal for commercial note when you have it, and I'll try to get the new CTO on call. :thumbsup:
Jamal Ortiz: noted. will update here with procurement reply.
Nora Liu: quick note — if we prove it's a config mismatch, a short config patch + restart usually restores 95% of activity. I'll aim for that before the call.
Alex Carter: great. closing loop later with a customer-friendly summary once we have remediation outcomes.
